command: cd /code && Rscript -e 'library(tidyverse); ds<-read_csv("/data/summary_stats_LSS2.csv", na="NaN"); ds<-filter(ds, id != 212 & id != 203); cat("speed medians:\n"); print(ds %>% pivot_longer(c(walk_path_speed, search_path_speed), names_to="task", values_to="speed") %>% group_by(task) %>% summarise(median=median(speed, na.rm=TRUE))); cat("straightness medians:\n"); print(ds %>% pivot_longer(c(walk_straightness, search_straightness), names_to="task", values_to="straightness") %>% group_by(task) %>% summarise(median=median(straightness, na.rm=TRUE)));' > /results/medians_lss2.txt 2>&1 && sed -n '1,120p' /results/medians_lss2.txt
